name: Ecos (India) Mobility & Hospitality Limited
summary: Ecos (India) Mobility & Hospitality Ltd. provides chauffeur-driven car rentals and employee shuttle services in India and abroad. Its fleet includes luggage vans, limousines, vintage cars and accessible vehicles, alongside self-drive rentals. It also handles transport logistics for conferences, delegations, events and weddings, and runs hotel travel desks.
